assessment: This manuscript describes application of x-ray crystallography and NMR spectroscopy to define how ANTH domains, which are present in endocytic machinery, bind to ubiquitin. The structural study is well-done, and results extended to the domain family by using well designed, structure-based amino acid substitutions. The Ub-binding surface was found to overlap with that used to bind VAMP8 but the authors identify mutations that retain this interaction while losing binding to Ub. These mutations are then used in yeast-based functional assays to provide new insights into Ub-dependent internalization. This study is an impressive tour de force.
